explanation: Its 'oom-pah-pah' pattern stresses the opening beat of each bar. Johann Strauss II, Vienna's 'Waltz King', wrote The Blue Danube in this rhythm.

claims.text: A waltz has three beats in each bar.
A waltz is not in two, four or six beats to the bar.
The waltz's oom-pah-pah accompaniment stresses the opening beat of each bar.
Johann Strauss II, known as the Waltz King, composed The Blue Danube waltz.
